steps.text: Hello, thanks for calling {{bank_name}}. You're speaking with the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded. Could I start with your full name, please?
Hi, it's Sarah Mitchell.
Thank you. How can I help you today?
I think I've lost my debit card. I had it at the gym last night and now I can't find it anywhere.

steps.summary: Caller has lost her debit card and is worried about it being used.

steps.text: Oh no, that's stressful. I can stop the card for you right now. First I just need to confirm a couple of details. What's your date of birth?
14th of September 1992.
Thank you. And what's the postcode where you live?
Thanks, {{submit_identity_answers.first_name}}, that's confirmed. Thank you for that. I'll need to place you on hold for a moment while I check the system. I'll be right back with you.
Thanks for holding. I can see your debit card. I'll report it lost now, so nobody can use it.

args.summary: Sarah lost her debit card ending 4821, last seen at the gym last night. Reported lost so it is blocked.
args.customer_statement: I think I've lost my debit card. I had it at the gym last night and now I can't find it anywhere.

steps.text: {{propose_action.customer_message}} Shall I order a new card for you now?
Yes please, that would be great.

steps.summary: Card ending 4821 reported lost and blocked. Sarah wants a replacement card.

steps.text: Of course. Because a new card is going out, I need to ask one more security question. {{start_identity_check.questions.0.prompt}}
Oh, I'm not sure exactly. It's different every fortnight.
That's fine, we can use a different one. {{start_identity_check.questions.1.prompt}}
Pulse Gym Cafe. I had a coffee there last night after my class.
Thank you, that's confirmed. Thanks, just a moment while I put that through in the system.

args.summary: Replacement for Sarah's lost debit card ending 4821, to the address on file.
args.customer_statement: Yes please, that would be great.

steps.text: Thanks for holding. {{propose_action.customer_message}}
So you can check nothing unfamiliar happened, the last purchase on the old card was eight dollars fifty at Pulse Gym Cafe, yesterday at six forty-two pm. That's the coffee you mentioned?
Yes, that was me.

steps.summary: Card ending 4821 reported lost and blocked, replacement ordered to the address on file. Sarah confirmed the last transaction was hers.

steps.text: Perfect, so nothing unfamiliar. I've sent you a text with the details. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. That was so easy, thank you.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Take care.
